$comment: Data for scripts/global/market-entry-report.mjs. Rules: nothing is 'done' without evidence; items tagged VERIFY also need source + verifiedOn; items tagged COUNSEL also need reviewer + reviewedOn. Items with a probe are derived from the code and cannot be set here. Nothing in this file is legal advice.

items.title: Contracting entity and establishment decided
items.description: Which Vireek entity signs customer contracts in this market, and whether it counts as established there.

items.title: Seller tax registration path decided
items.description: VAT / GST / sales-tax registration duty and thresholds for Vireek as a seller (not the tenant's registrations in tax_registrations).

items.title: Local representative requirement assessed
items.description: Statutory representative or similar local presence (data protection, tax, consumer). 'not_applicable' is only valid with counsel's written conclusion.

items.title: Local payment methods and currency supported in code
items.description: Country profile lists at least one method that can settle in the country's currency, and the currency is chargeable.

items.title: Payments and e-invoicing matrix row complete and verified
items.description: The country's row in config/global/payments-einvoicing.json is complete (verified source, reviewer, counsel reviewer, fresh).

items.title: Processor account can settle the currency and methods
items.description: The live processor account is approved for the currency and each enabled method (account-level, not only API support).

items.title: Local number inventory confirmed
items.description: Number types available to provision in the country (local / mobile / toll-free), cost and any capacity limits.

items.title: Number registration and sender rules cleared
items.description: Identity/address bundles, brand or sender registration for voice and SMS required before numbers can be used.

items.title: Call-recording consent and AI-disclosure profile approved
items.description: Recording mode and scripts for this market, reviewed against docs/compliance/voice-consent-and-ai-disclosure.md.

items.title: Human support window covers the market
items.description: Declared human-support hours overlap the market's business day. Today a single window exists in src/lib/supportHours.ts.

items.title: Support macros and escalation path ready in the market language
items.description: Reviewed canned replies, escalation owner and out-of-hours behaviour.

items.title: Privacy-request tooling covers the regime
items.description: Access / erasure / portability handling and deadlines exist in code for the regimes that apply.

items.title: Marketing and messaging consent rules approved
items.description: Email / SMS / call consent rules (CASL, PECR, Spam Act, CAN-SPAM, TCPA, ePrivacy) reviewed for this market.

items.title: Data residency and transfer basis decided
items.description: Transfer mechanism and residency stance for this market's customers, see docs/compliance/adr-0001-data-residency.md.

items.title: Sub-processor list matches the real data flow
items.description: Public sub-processor page and DPA annex reflect the providers actually called for this market.

items.title: UI language available at release quality
items.description: The country's main language is a non-beta locale in src/i18n/locales.config.ts.

items.title: Phone, postal and address rules implemented
items.description: The country has a CountryProfile with phone and postal validation in the regional pack.

items.title: Holiday calendar coverage
items.description: Public/bank holiday calendar used for scheduling and deadline maths.

items.title: Required legal pages published in the market language
items.description: Legal notice / privacy / terms pages the market requires (for example a German Impressum), in the right language.

compliance.privacy_tooling.note: Code inspection only (CCPA, CAN-SPAM regimes present). Legal fitness is covered by the COUNSEL items.
Code inspection only (PIPEDA, QC_LAW25, CASL regimes present).
Code inspection only (AU_PRIVACY, AU_SPAM regimes present).
